title: RLPolicy RobotPickPlaceComparison

stats.done_summary:
Successfully completed the RL Policy Robot Pick-and-Place Comparison research task. 

**Deliverables created:**
- `code/analysis.py` - Comprehensive analysis script with 4 visualizations
- `outputs/improvements.csv` - Processed improvement metrics
- `report/images/` - 4 publication-quality figures:
  - fig1_all_metrics_comparison.png (side-by-side metric comparison)
  - fig2_improvement_percentages.png (relative improvement analysis)
  - fig3_sim_to_real_gap.png (simulation-to-reality gap)
  - fig4_radar_comparison.png (holistic performance profiles)
- `report/report.md` - Full research report with:
  - Executive summary with deployment recommendation
  - Methodology section
  - Results with all 4 figures referenced
  - Discussion of efficiency vs safety trade-offs
  - Conditional deployment recommendation with phased approach
  - Risk assessment and alternative recommendations

**Key Finding:** pi_new shows 11% faster cycle times and 3% better success rates than pi_base, but exhibits critical safety concerns with 3-4× higher safety intervention rates. Recommendation: Conditional deployment of pi_new with mandatory safety system enhancements.
